Phase 5 Increment 01: multi-line sales cart, checkout idempotency key, branch-scoped sales history, sale detail and print view.
Phase 5 Increment 02: cumulative refund cap evaluated against original collections minus all recorded prior refunds while locking the source sale.
Phase 5 Increment 02: branch-scoped returns list and payment/return/refund ledger details on sale detail.

Phase 5 Increment 02: staging-only Playwright cases for split tender, partial payment, idempotent retry, stock ledger read-after-write, cumulative refund limit, cashier permission denial, manager positive price/discount, and optional cross-branch denial.

Phase 5 final gate review (2026-10-21): pinned GitHub revision d228e6467894857aeeb632a189d10680179404db; Vercel Node 24.x production build is ready, while the same-commit Render startup failed because workspace/membership routes import a missing shared refresh-cookie helper.

Updated cookie hardening regression contract and added a source-level shared-cookie import regression test.

Phase 5 Increment 03: compute cumulative refund allowance from gross recorded payment allocations minus every prior recorded refund; do not subtract earlier refunds twice from the already-net sale.amount_paid value.
Phase 5 Increment 03: recompute sale paid/due values from the payment, refund and customer-credit ledgers; refund-table mutations refresh their source sale through an AFTER trigger.
Phase 5 Increment 03: partial returns prorate line total, discount and tax by returned quantity rather than reusing full-line adjustments.

Phase 5 Increment 03: no-refund returns are bounded by the customer open receivable in both the API and accounting-journal function; choose refund/customer-credit settlement when the receivable is insufficient.
Phase 5 Increment 03: post idempotent sale-return settlement journal entries, returned-inventory COGS reversals and a pending EFRIS CREDIT_NOTE only for active registered tenants.
Phase 5 Increment 03: add dedicated 2210 customer store-credit liability mapping; distinguish issued credit from amounts allocated to a particular receivable.
Phase 5 Increment 03: analytics credit/outstanding values read the authoritative sales.amount_due value instead of independently recalculating and drifting after refunds/returns.
Phase 5 Increment 03: sale details and return list surface associated accounting-journal and fiscal-document states in the frontend.

Added migration 033 for cumulative refund settlement, refund ledger synchronization and authoritative analytics balances; migration 034 for return settlement/COGS journals, customer-credit liability and optional EFRIS credit notes; migration 035 for the no-refund/open-receivable invariant.
Added Phase 5 rule tests, source-contract tests and migration-contract tests; authenticated Playwright test runner remains fail-closed and requires explicit staging-only opt-in.
